title: Spoooky Deck
name: Name
disclaimer: Readings are entertainment, not business advice.
heroText: Draw a card and the deck will tell what awaits your company.
formText: Give your name, zodiac sign and the company you work for. Your details stay on your device.
licensesText: Music: generated with the ACE-Step model (MIT). Fonts: Olde Tome, Old English Gothic Pixel and Geist Pixel. Emoji: SerenityOS. Sound: ZzFX. Randomness: seedrandom. Readings: Tracery.
musicHint: Tap the screen to start the music
installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
installOther: Open your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
keyHow: Under the card you see four labels. Here is what they mean and how they shape the reading:
keyMajor: A Major Arcana card is one of 22 cards with big themes for a company: change, brand, direction. Such a card sets the main thread of the reading.
keyMinor: A Minor Arcana card is one of 56 cards in four suits and covers everyday company matters. The suit shows the area:
suit_cups: Cups: client relationships, emotions, user experience
suit_pentacles: Pentacles: money, sales, image in clients' eyes
keySignText: The zodiac sign colors the reading: it shows how you experience the company's problem. Its sentence is the third paragraph of the reading:
keyElementText: Each sign has an element (fire, earth, air or water), and the minor suits have their own: Wands are fire, Cups water, Swords air, Pentacles earth. Whether your sign matches the card is commented on by a separate sentence in the reading.
keyElMatch: Your sign and the card share an element, so they resonate: the card speaks of something close to you.
keyElDiff: Your sign and the card have different elements, so the card shows something that is a challenge for you.
keyElMajor: Major Arcana have no single element, so this reading has no sentence about the element.
keyPosUp: An upright card shows its main, bright meaning. It picks exactly those keywords and sentences.
keyPosRev: A reversed card shows the darker side of its meaning: an obstacle, a delay or a lack. The keywords and sentences change.
keyServiceText: Each card points to a service that fits the problem, and the reading ends with the conclusion that a designer is needed. For this card:
shareText: My card: {card}. See what reading the deck has for your company.
